items.text: Shoko raJehovha rakauya kuna Mika weMoresheti panguva yokutonga kwaJotamu, Ahazi naHezekia, madzimambo aJudha, chiratidzo chaakaona pamusoro peSamaria neJerusarema.
Inzwai, imi marudzi avanhu, imi mose,
teerera, iwe nyika navose vari mauri,
Tarirai! Jehovha ari kubuda panzvimbo yaanogara:
anoburuka pasi agotsika panzvimbo dzakakwirira dzenyika.
Zvose izvi zvakaitika nokuda kwokudarika kwaJakobho,
Zvose zvifananidzo zvaro zvichaputswa kuita zvimedu;
zvose zvipo zvaro zvomutemberi zvichapiswa nomoto;
Sezvo akaunganidza zvipo zvake kubva pamibayiro yezvifeve,
ndichafamba ndisina shangu mutsoka uye ndisina kupfeka.
nokuti njodzi yasvika ichibva kuna Jehovha,

items.text: "Ndiri kuronga njodzi yokurwisa nayo vanhu ava,
Naizvozvo muchashayiwa munhu kana mumwe, muungano yaJehovha,
Zvingataurwe here, nhai imi imba yaJakobho, kuti:
kuno uyo ane nzira dzake dzakarurama?
pane avo vanopfuura musina kana hanya,
Nokuti ino haisi nzvimbo yenyu yokuzororera,
zvirokwazvo ndichaunganidza pamwe chete vakasara vaIsraeri.
seboka pamafuro aro; nzvimbo yacho ichazara navanhu.
Uyo achaparura nzira achaenda pamberi pavo;
Mambo wavo achapfuura ari pamberi pavo,

items.text: Unganidza mauto ako, iwe guta ramauto,
kunyange uri muduku pakati pamarudzi aJudha,
kusvikira panguva iyo, iye anorwadziwa azvara
nokuti ipapo kukura kwake kuchasvika kumagumo enyika.
kuti vamurwise kunyange vatungamiri vasere vavanhu.
Ndichadzura kubva pakati penyu matanda aAshera

items.text: teererai, imi hwaro hwenyika hunogara nokusingaperi.
Nokuti Jehovha ane mhosva yaari kupa vanhu vake;
Rangarirai rwendo rwenyu kubva kuShitimu kusvika kuGirigari,
Uye ndigokotama sei pamberi paMwari anokudzwa?
zvinopiswa nemhuru dzine gore rimwe here?
uye nezviuru gumi zvenzizi dzamafuta here?
Ndingapa dangwe rangu nokuda kwokudarika kwangu,
icho chibereko chomuviri wangu pamusoro pokutadza kwomweya wangu here?
Akakuratidza, iwe munhu, kuti zvakanaka ndezvipi.
Uye ndezvipi zvinodiwa naJehovha kubva kwauri?
Kuita zvakarurama uye kufarira kunzwira ngoni,
uye kutya zita renyu ndihwo uchenjeri:
muchasvina maorivhi asi hamungazori mafuta acho,
muchasvina mazambiringa asi hamunganwi waini yacho.
uye namabasa ose eimba yaAhabhu, uye makatevera tsika dzavo.

items.text: Vanhu vose vanovandira kuti vateure ropa;
mumwe nomumwe anovhima hama yake nomumbure.
Maoko ose ari maviri ane unyanzvi pakuita zvakaipa;
mubati anomanikidzira vanhu kuti vamupe zvipo,
vakarurama kupfuura vose vakaipa kupfuura ruzhowa rweminzwa.
Zvino ino ndiyo nguva yokukanganiswa kwavo.
vavengi vomunhu ndivo vanhu vemhuri yake.
Asi kana ndirini, ndinomirira netariro kuna Jehovha,
Usafara pamusoro pangu, iwe muvengi wangu!
uye kubva kugungwa kusvika kune rimwe gungwa,
nokubva kugomo kusvika kune rimwe gomo.
Nyika ichava dongo nokuda kwavagari vayo,
Vachabuda vachidedera kubva munzvimbo dzavo dzokuvanda;
vachadzoka vachitya kuna Jehovha Mwari wedu,
uye muchakanda kuipa kwedu kwose pakadzikadzika mugungwa.
